h1: Get Found by the Customers Searching for You

points: Free website audit of your current website
Google Business Profile optimisation and management
Honest advice, with no promised rankings

form.heading: Get your free website audit
form.intro: Tell us about your business and include your website address in your message. We will reply by email.

sections.heading: Get found by the customers closest to you
body: Most local customers start with a search. Local SEO makes sure your business appears when someone nearby looks for what you do, with a well-structured website and a complete, active Google Business Profile.

We focus on the practical work that helps local businesses be found and trusted: a site that search engines can understand, an optimised Business Profile, and content that answers what customers actually ask.

sections.heading: What our SEO services include
sections.intro: Available with our managed website plans or as a standalone service.

items.title: Basic SEO setup
items.body: Every website plan includes a search-friendly structure, page titles and descriptions and basic analytics.

items.title: Google Business Profile optimisation
items.body: We optimise your profile so your business information, services and categories are complete and accurate.

items.title: On-page SEO optimisation
items.body: The Business plan adds on-page optimisation across your pages so each one is clear about what it offers.

items.title: Profile management
items.body: The Business plan includes Google Business Profile management for one location, including reviews and customer replies.

items.title: SEO blog content
items.body: The Business plan includes one to two SEO blog posts per month to answer customer questions and support search visibility.

items.title: Custom SEO strategy for larger needs
items.body: The E-Commerce plan adds a custom SEO strategy and execution, with profile management for up to four locations.

sections.heading: How our SEO work is delivered
sections.intro: A clear, practical process that starts with where you are today.

steps.title: Free website audit
steps.body: We review your current website and Google Business Profile and tell you what needs attention.

steps.title: Fix the foundation
steps.body: Page titles, descriptions, structure and speed are set up so search engines can understand your site.

steps.title: Build your local presence
steps.body: We optimise your Google Business Profile and add content that answers what your customers ask.

steps.title: Report and adjust
steps.body: Analytics show what is working, and we adjust the plan so effort goes where it pays off.

sections.heading: No promised rankings
body: Search results depend on many factors outside anyone's control, including competition and search engine changes, so we do not promise rankings or a specific number of calls. What we do is the consistent, practical work that gives your business the best chance of being found.
Local SEO works best on top of a fast, clear website. It is included in our managed website plans, and it is also available as a standalone service. Talk to us on a discovery call about which fits.
